objective: Reconcile the canonical domain matrix and closure evidence with the Supabase-only authentication runtime while preserving external blockers without reviving local authority.

resolvedHistoricalBlockers.resolution: Supabase is the only browser auth provider; provider selection by query, storage or window config was retired.
Refresh, recovery, reauthentication and local/global logout authority are implemented and validated; verified contact changes remain separately blocked by external providers.

externalBlockers.reason: Verified e-mail change requires controlled transactional delivery, redirect, expiry and replay canaries.
Verified phone change remains unavailable until an SMS provider and cost policy are configured.
Supabase leaked-password protection requires a paid plan.

nextEngineeringHandoff: PROF-001 may proceed as the next core domain while AUTH-001 remains production-blocked by explicit external dependencies.
